config.note_dataset: BNCI2014-001 / BCI Competition IV-2a: motor IMAGERY, 2 sessions x 288 trials.
config.deletion_test_prediction: plain forward pass (no TTA) so removals are compared deterministically
config.model_fixed: braindecode EEGITNet defaults (drop_prob from the profile)
config.checkpoint_rule: SWA average from swa_start_frac*max_epochs + BN update (no early stopping); validation block only scored, never used for checkpointing
config.folds: 4 chronological blocks; test block i, validation block i-1, rest train (original: shuffled StratifiedKFold(4), no validation set)

attribution.target: pre-softmax logit of the true class

faithfulness.removal: channel set to 0 (its standardised mean) on the TEST block; evaluation only, never used for any choice
faithfulness.ranking: mean of the four attribution maps from the VALIDATION block

config.randomisation_check: Spearman between trained-model and untrained-model saliency
